AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 76 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7768, #7769, #7773, #7774 and #7775:

- #7768 → #5963: `audit:complete` (platform-context programming-model design).
- #7769 → #7766: `audit:complete` (checked Custom-period arithmetic).
- #7773 → #7771: `audit:complete` (checked Week-period/DST-boundary arithmetic).
- #7774 → #5869: `audit:complete` (backup, recovery and provider-exit design).

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issue/comment captures, later-PR evidence, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7768-7775/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7768-7775.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 76 valid PRs audited from 80 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 170 identifiers remain, next #7776. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
